original_value: The development of Internet and social media contributes to multiplying the data produced on the Internet and the connected nodes, but the default installation and the configuration of variety of software systems represent some security holes and shortcomings, while the majority of Internet users have not really set up safety awareness, leading to huge security risks. With the development of network attack techniques, every host on the Internet has become the target of attacks. Therefore, the network information security cannot be ignored as a problem. To deal with 0-day and future attacks, the honeypot technique can be used not only passively as an information system, but also to reinforce the traditional defense systems against future attacks. In this paper, we present an introduction of machine learning and honeypot systems, and based on these technologies, we design a smart agent for cyber-attack prevention and prediction.

result.paraphrase: The growth of the Internet and social media is multiplying the amount of data generated across the Internet and connected nodes, yet default installations and the configuration of various software systems still leave security gaps and weaknesses. At the same time, most Internet users have not developed strong security awareness, which creates major security risks. As network attack techniques continue to advance, every host on the Internet has become a potential target. For this reason, network information security must not be overlooked. To address 0-day and future attacks, honeypot technology can serve not only as a passive information system but also as a means to strengthen traditional defense systems against future threats. This paper introduces machine learning and honeypot systems and, using these technologies, designs a smart agent for cyber-attack prevention and prediction.
